plain: A former Pentagon intelligence official named Chris Mellon is said to have wanted to question the CIA's Director of Science and Technology, a woman who held the post fairly recently, because, in his words as relayed, "we need to figure out what she knows about UFOs." Michels tells this as something Mellon said to him, and he is unsure exactly which director it was. If it is true, it would mean someone who follows this closely believed that senior CIA science officials know something about UFOs.
